name: SkyBall Survival
author: RkVirus
description: In "Sky Ball Survival," embark on a thrilling journey where survival is key. Navigate the dynamic world as the resilient black ball, your sole mission to outlast relentless white ball enemies. Unleash your strategic prowess by collecting power-ups that grant you a protective ring. The ring becomes your shield, allowing you to confidently face and overcome the challenges posed by the adversarial white balls. Test your reflexes, dodge enemies, and embrace the intensity of survival in this captivating game. How long can you endure the chaos and emerge as the ultimate survivor? The fate of the black ball rests in your hands. Special thanks to Ravi (Programming), Swati (Texture), Shilpi (Content) ✨
